login.subtitle: Injira kugira ngo ukomeze kugenzura ibikubiyemo ukoresheje VerifyAI.

errors.network: Ntibishoboka kugera kuri seriveri. Reba interineti yawe wongere ugerageze.
errors.lockout: Konti yahagaritswe by'agateganyo nyuma yo kugerageza inshuro nyinshi bidakunze. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'iminota 30 cyangwa uhindure ijambobanga ryawe.

demo.hint: Kanda kuri konti iyo ari yo yose kugira ngo wuzuze ifishi. Ziremwa mu buryo bwikora na komandi yo gutera imbuto.

brand.subtext: Igenzura ry'ukuri rishingiye ku buhanga bwa AI ryubakiwe abaturage, ibitangazamakuru na guverinoma.

ensemble.title: Ihuriro ry'imitwe itatu
ensemble.body: Naive Bayes, LSTM na DistilBERT bisuzumwa hamwe kugira ngo ibyemezo bibe bikomeye.

explainable.title: Ibisubizo bisobanutse
explainable.body: Buri gusobanura kuza n'amagambo y'ingenzi, ibimenyetso, n'impamvu biri inyuma yacyo.

standards.title: Bihuye n'amahame
standards.body: Byateguwe hakurikijwe amahame y'ifatizo ya IFCN, C2PA, JTI na DSA.
